decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper extends the firm's established construction range, still has its own page in 2024, and fits its core rental and contractor customers.
The articulated dumper sits in the firm's core construction line and remained prominently presented in 2024.
The mine rescue vehicle is a niche product far from the core and was downgraded from its own page to a mention in 2024, but specialist custom machines are usually kept available on request.
The compact telescopic loader builds on established know-how and kept a dedicated page in 2024.
The Easy 18 material lift is a long-popular rental product that just won a large order, so there is no reason to drop it.
The compact mining loader shows strong field results (1,000 hours in 7 months) and has its own page, which supports further market development.
